title: Custom Software Development
desc: We build web applications, APIs, and internal tools from a defined brief — using modern frameworks, delivered in sprints with working software at every milestone.

title: Product Engineering
desc: We work as an embedded engineering team on your product — from MVP to production scale — with the architecture and practices to grow without a rebuild.

title: Application Modernisation
desc: We migrate legacy monoliths, re-platform to cloud, and introduce API layers on top of ageing systems — incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite.

title: UX / UI Design
desc: We design interfaces that are clear, usable, and aligned to how users actually work — from discovery and wireframes through to production-ready design systems.

title: Cloud & DevOps
desc: We design and manage cloud infrastructure — provisioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and cost controls — so your engineering team ships faster with fewer incidents.

title: Quality Engineering
desc: We build test automation frameworks and QA practices that catch issues before users do — integrated into your delivery pipeline from day one.

title: Managed App Support
desc: We take operational responsibility for live applications — monitoring, incident response, bug fixes, and minor enhancements — so your team can focus on new development.

title: Tech Due Diligence
desc: We conduct structured technical assessments for investors, acquirers, and leadership teams — covering architecture, code quality, security posture, and team capability.
